# Echo Universal API — LLM Context Bundle

Paste this file as context for GPT-4o, Gemini, local models (LM Studio, Ollama), or any
LLM that does not load the full repo. Single-file, self-contained.

Source: https://github.com/NetVar1337/echo-ai-toolkit
Full API: https://echo-23.gitbook.io/angel/llms-full.txt
Full reference: `reference/api.md`

---

## What Echo is

External scripting platform for Windows games. Scripts are **AngelScript** (C-like,
statically typed, no exceptions, `@` object handles, `is null` null-check). Echo runs
outside the game process: direct memory access, no injection, a Discord overlay renderer,
Zydis disassembly, a Unicorn CPU emulator, JSON/HTTP/WebSocket/file I/O, and a menu with
config persistence.

Scripts live in `%AppData%\Roaming\scripts\*.as`. No compile step — reload from the
overlay menu.

---

## Hard rules (get these wrong and the script will not compile or will crash)

1. **Entry point is `bool main()`.** Return `true` on success, `false` to unload.
   `void main()` does not compile.
2. **Every call must exist in the API below.** Anything outside the namespaces listed here
   does not exist — see `reference/_API_CONTRACT.md` for the full old→new mapping.
   The namespaces are `process::`, `render::`, `ui::`, `uc::`, `zydis::`, `util::`,
   `file::`, `dir::`, `input::`, `json::`, `http::`, `ws::`, `console::`, `alert::`,
   `math::`, `hash::`, `trace::`, `source::`, `source2::`, `unreal::`, `unity::`,
   `iw_engine::`.
3. **Colours are four separate ints** `r, g, b, a` (0–255). No colour struct parameter
   on render calls. (`struct color { int r,g,b,a; }` exists only for
   `ui::get`/`ui::set` on a colour picker.)
4. **W2S writes to an out-param and returns `bool`.**
   `vec2 screen; if (!source2::w2s(world_pos, view_matrix, screen)) return;`
5. **`process::find_signature` needs a base address** — get it with
   `process::get_module_base("game.exe")` first.
6. **Render calls only work inside the render thread** — register with
   `on_render(@cb)`. Exceptions callable anywhere: `render::get_fps`,
   `render::get_frametime`, `render::is_foreground`, `render::get_viewport_size`,
   `render::load_font`, `render::load_image`.
7. **UI element order matters**: `ui::add_tab` → `ui::add_subtab` → `ui::add_category` →
   elements. Elements attach to the most recent category.
8. **UI values are read through handles**: `bool v = ui::get(checkbox);`,
   `ui::set(checkbox, v);`
9. **No exceptions, no try/catch.** Check return values. `process::read_*` returns the
   default value on failure.
10. **Addresses are always `uint64`.** Never `uint32` — it truncates 64-bit pointers.
11. **Null check is `is null`**, never `== null`. Array length is `arr.length()`, never
    `arr.size()`.
12. **Never invent a helper function.** If a convenience function is needed, write it out
    in the script — it is user code, not API.

---

## Script skeleton

```angelscript
void on_unload() {
    // teardown
}

bool main() {
    return true;
}
```

---

## Threading

```angelscript
mutex@ m = create_mutex();          // mutex.lock/unlock/lock_shared/unlock_shared/try_lock

atomic_bool@     atomic_bool(bool value);
atomic_int32@    atomic_int32(int value);
atomic_uint32@   atomic_uint32(uint value);
atomic_int64@    atomic_int64(int64 value);
atomic_uint64@   atomic_uint64(uint64 value);
atomic_float@    atomic_float(float value);
atomic_double@   atomic_double(double value);
// .load() .store(v) .exchange(v) .compare_exchange(expected, desired)

void create_thread(int tps, thread_callback@ cb);  // tps 1-128; 0 = run once
void on_render(thread_callback@ cb);                // every frame, render thread
void sleep(uint ms);
```

Ticking threads (`tps` 1–128) can only be created from `main()`. One-shot threads
(`tps == 0`) can be created from any context. Never create a thread with `tps == 0` and
expect a loop — it runs once and exits.

Shared state across threads must be guarded: unsynchronised global access races the
AngelScript engine and can take the whole process down. Build a snapshot locally, swap it
in under the mutex, let readers take their own handle and read lock-free.

```angelscript
mutex@ g_lock = create_mutex();
int g_counter = 0;

void tick() {
    g_lock.lock();
    g_counter++;
    g_lock.unlock();
}

bool main() {
    create_thread(64, @tick);
    on_render(@render_tick);
    return true;
}
```

---

## Process / memory

```angelscript
struct attach_data { uint64 pid; uint64 peb_address; uint64 base_address; }
struct module_entry { string name; uint64 base; uint64 size; }
struct memory_region { uint64 base; uint64 size; bool present; bool writable; bool executable; }

attach_data process::attach(string name);      // pid == 0 means failure
attach_data process::attach(uint32 pid);
void process::detach();
bool process::is_alive();

// reads — value form, default on failure
array<uint8>@ process::read_bytes(uint64 address, uint32 size);  // null on failure
int8/uint8/int16/uint16/int32/uint32/int64/uint64/float/double
        process::read_<type>(uint64 address);
string process::read_string(uint64 address);   // null-terminated, 256 char max

// reads — out-param form, true on success
bool process::read_uint64(uint64 address, uint64 &out);   // and every other type
bool process::read_string(uint64 address, string &out);

// writes — true on success
bool process::write_bytes(array<uint8> bytes, uint64 address);   // bytes FIRST
bool process::write_uint64(uint64 address, uint64 value);
bool process::write_int32(uint64 address, int32 value);
bool process::write_float(uint64 address, float value);
bool process::write_double(uint64 address, double value);      // + all other widths

// modules
uint64 process::get_module_base(string name);       // 0 if not found
uint32 process::get_module_size(uint64 base);        // 0 if not found
uint64 process::get_module_export(uint64 base, string name);  // 0 if not found
array<module_entry>@ process::get_module_list();

// signatures — need a base address, return 0 if not found
uint64 process::find_signature(uint64 base, string sig, string mask);
uint64 process::find_signature(uint64 base, string sig);              // IDA-style
uint64 process::find_signature(uint64 base, string sig, string mask, uint64 range_offset, uint64 range_length);
array<uint64>@ process::find_signatures(uint64 base, string sig, string mask);
array<uint64>@ process::find_signatures(uint64 base, string sig);
uint64 process::get_relative_address(uint64 address, uint32 offset, uint32 inst_size);

memory_region process::virtual_query(uint64 address);
bool process::dump(string filename);
bool process::dump(string module_name, string filename);
bool process::open_socket(const string url);   // JSON-over-WebSocket client
```

Masked scan: `sig` = hex bytes, `mask` uses `x` to match, `?` to wildcard.
IDA-style scan: wildcards are `?` or `??`.

### Bulk reads — memory_buffer

`memory_buffer@ process::read_buffer(uint64 address, uint64 size)` — **null on failure**.
One read, many field reads.

`read_uint8/read_uint16/read_uint32/read_uint64/read_int8/read_int16/read_int32/
read_int64/read_float/read_double/read_vec2_float/read_vec2_double/read_vec3_float/
read_vec3_double/read_vec4_float/read_vec4_double(offset)`, `uint64 size()`.

```angelscript
uint64 base = process::get_module_base("cs2.exe");
if (base == 0) return false;
uint64 sig = process::find_signature(base, "48 8B 0D ? ? ? ?");
if (sig == 0) return false;
uint64 target = process::get_relative_address(sig, 3, 7);
uint64 health = process::read_uint64(target);
```

## Render (render thread only)

```angelscript
float render::get_fps();                       // any context
float render::get_frametime();                 // any context
bool render::is_foreground();                  // any context
vec2 render::get_viewport_size();              // any context
bool render::get_viewport_size(int &out width, int &out height);
void render::set_anti_aliasing(bool enabled);

void render::draw_box(int x, int y, int w, int h, int r, int g, int b, int a, box_style style, float rounding);
void render::draw_gradient_box(int x, int y, int w, int h,
        int r1,int g1,int b1,int a1, int r2,int g2,int b2,int a2, bool horizontal);
void render::draw_line(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, int r,int g,int b,int a, float thickness = 1.0f);
void render::draw_line_outlined(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, int r,int g,int b,int a, float thickness = 1.0f);
void render::draw_circle(float x, float y, float radius, int r,int g,int b,int a, bool filled = false, int segments = 32);
void render::draw_triangle(float x1,float y1, float x2,float y2, float x3,float y3, int r,int g,int b,int a, bool filled = false);
void render::draw_concave_poly(array<vec2> points, int r,int g,int b,int a);
void render::draw_convex_poly(array<vec2> points, int r,int g,int b,int a, bool filled);
void render::draw_polyline(array<vec2> points, int r,int g,int b,int a, float thickness, bool closed);
void render::draw_hue_bar(int x, int y, int w, int h, int r,int g,int b,int a);
void render::draw_hue_bar_static(int x, int y, int w, int h, int r,int g,int b,int a);

void render::draw_text(int x, int y, string text, int r,int g,int b,int a);
void render::draw_text_outlined(int x, int y, string text, int r,int g,int b,int a);
void render::draw_text_shadow(int x, int y, string text, int r,int g,int b,int a);
vec2 render::calculate_text_size(string text);

bool render::load_font(const array<uint8> &in, font_handle &out, font_hint = font_hint::AUTO);
void render::update_font(fonts font, int size);
bool render::load_image(string data, image &out obj);
void render::draw_image(image obj, int x, int y, int w, int h);

bbox_2d render::calculate_2d_bbox(vec3 origin, vec3 mins, vec3 maxs, matrix4x4 view_matrix);
bbox_2d render::calculate_2d_bbox_unity(vec3 origin, vec3 center, vec3 extents, matrix4x4 view_matrix);
```

`enum box_style { NORMAL, OUTLINED, FILLED, FILLED_OUTLINED, CORNERED, CORNERED_FILLED }`.
`enum fonts { PROGGY, TAHOMA, TAHOMA_PX, TAHOMA_BOLD, TAHOMA_BOLD_PX, SMALLEST_PIXEL_7, TAHOMISH }`.
`enum font_hint { NONE, AUTO, MONO }`.

```angelscript
void render_tick() {
    vec2 vp = render::get_viewport_size();
    render::draw_box(100, 100, 200, 50, 255, 0, 0, 255, box_style::FILLED, 0.0f);
    render::draw_box(100, 100, 200, 50, 255, 0, 0, 255, box_style::OUTLINED, 0.0f);
    render::draw_line(0, 0, vp.x, vp.y, 255, 255, 255, 255, 1.0f);
    render::draw_circle(50, 50, 10, 0, 255, 0, 255, true, 32);
    render::draw_text(10, 10, "hello", 255, 255, 255, 255);
}
```

```angelscript
checkbox    ui::add_checkbox(string label, bool default_value, string config_key = "");
checkbox    ui::add_checkbox(string label, bool default_value, checkbox_callback@ cb = nullptr, string config_key = "");

button      ui::add_button(string label, button_callback@ cb = nullptr);

bool ui::get(checkbox);
int ui::get(slider);
color ui::get(color_picker);            // struct color { int r,g,b,a; }

bool ui::get(multi_select, uint64 index);

void ui::set(checkbox, bool value);
void ui::set(slider, int value);

void ui::set_visible(element, bool visible);
void ui::add_tooltip(element, string text);
void ui::set_label_style(checkbox, label_style style);
```

**The slider is integer-only.** `enum sub_tab_side { middle, left, right }`.
`enum category_pos { automatic, left_full, right_full, left_top, left_bottom, right_top, right_bottom }`.
`enum label_style { none, warning, dangerous }`.

```angelscript
checkbox g_enabled = false;
slider g_fov = 60;

bool main() {
    ui::config_path("my_script");
    ui::add_tab("Main");
    ui::add_category("Options");
    g_enabled = ui::add_checkbox("Enable", false);
    g_fov = ui::add_slider("FOV", 60, 5, 300, 5, "deg");
    return true;
}

void tick() {
    bool on = ui::get(g_enabled);
    int fov = ui::get(g_fov);
}
```

## World to screen (all return bool, all use an out-param)

```angelscript
bool source::w2s(vec3 world_pos, matrix4x4 view_matrix, vec2 &out screen_pos);
bool source2::w2s(vec3 world_pos, matrix4x4 view_matrix, vec2 &out screen_pos);
bool unity::w2s(vec3 world_pos, matrix4x4 view_matrix, vec2 &out screen_pos);
bool unreal::w2s(vec3 world_pos, f_view_cache cache, vec2 &out screen_pos);
bool iw_engine::w2s(vec3 world_pos, vec3 camera_location, matrix3x3 view_matrix, float fov_x, float fov_y, vec2 &out screen_pos);
```

`false` means off-screen or behind the camera — skip the draw.

Unreal: build `f_view_cache` once per frame with
`f_view_cache build_view_cache(f_view_info camera, bool vertical_fov = false)`.
`f_view_info` has `.location` (vec3), `.rotation` (vec3 pitch/yaw/roll), `.fov` (float).

## Math, vectors, matrices

```angelscript
math::PI  math::TAU  math::RAD2DEG  math::DEG2RAD
angle_range::R_180   angle_range::R_360

matrix4x4 math::multiply_matrix(matrix4x4 a, matrix4x4 b);
matrix4x4 math::rotation_matrix(vec3 rotation, vec3 origin);
vec3 math::rotated_vector(vec3 point, vec4 quaternion);
vec3 math::forward_vector(vec2 angles);
vec3 math::right_vector(vec2 angles);
vec3 math::up_vector(vec2 angles);

vec2  math::vec_to_angles(vec3 direction);
vec3  math::angles_to_vec(vec2 angles);
double math::normalize_angle(double angle, angle_range range);
double math::angle_diff(double a, double b);
double math::calculate_fov(vec2 a, vec2 b);
vec2  math::calculate_angle(vec3 from, vec3 to);
vec2  math::clamp_angles(vec2 angles, angle_range range);
vec2  math::smooth_angles(vec2 current, vec2 target, angle_range range, double smoothing, double min_speed, double max_speed);

vec2 math::unreal_rotation_to_radians(vec3 camera_rot);
double math::unreal_calculate_fov(vec3 camera_rot, vec3 camera_pos, vec3 target_pos);
vec2 math::unreal_calculate_angle(vec3 camera_rot, vec3 camera_pos, vec3 target_pos);
vec2 math::unreal_smooth_rotation(vec3 camera_rot, vec3 camera_pos, vec3 target_pos, double smoothing, double min_speed, double max_speed);
```

`vec2` / `vec3` / `vec4`: `.x .y .z .w`; methods `.is_empty() .length() .length_squared()
.normalize() .dot(other) .add(other) .subtract(other) .multiply(scalar) .distance(other)
.lerp(other, t) .read_float(addr) .read_double(addr) .write_float(addr) .write_double(addr)`.

`matrix4x4` / `matrix3x4` / `matrix3x3`: `m[row][col]`, `bool m.read(address)`,
`bool m.read_double(address)`.

Interpolation lives on the vector type: `v.lerp(other, t)`. There is no scalar lerp helper
in `math::`.

```angelscript

//           get_string/get_float/get_double/get_int/get_uint/get_int64/get_uint64/get_bool/get_obj(key)
//           get_*_at(index)

// Hash map — uint64 keys, dynamically typed values
hash_map@ create_hash_map();
map.set_bool/set_int32/set_uint32/set_int64/set_uint64/set_float/set_double/set_string(key, v);
bool map.get_bool/get_int32/.../get_string(key, &out);   // true only if key exists AND type matches

uint map.size(); bool map.empty(); void map.clear();

// Hash set

bool s.insert(v); bool s.erase(v); bool s.contains(v); uint s.size(); bool s.empty(); void s.clear();
```

## Networking

```angelscript
struct http_response { int status_code; string body; string error; }

void http::get(string url, response_callback@ cb);   // callback form: main() ONLY
void http::post(string url, string body, string content_type, response_callback@ cb);
void http::get(string url);                         // fire-and-forget: any context
void http::post(string url, string body, string content_type);

void ws::connect(string url, connect_callback@ on_open, message_callback@ on_message,
                 disconnect_callback@ on_disconnect, error_callback@ on_error);

```

WebSocket callbacks fire on the connection thread — guard shared state.

## Zydis / Unicorn (RE)

```angelscript
// Zydis
array<uint8>@ bytes = process::read_bytes(addr, 64);
array<disasm_insn@> insns;
if (!zydis::disasm(bytes, addr, insns)) return;      // rip base resolves RIP-relative operands
if (!zydis::disasm_func(bytes, addr, insns)) return;  // until first ret; false if >4096 insns
string zydis::reg_name(int reg);
// insn.text, insn.runtime_address, insn.length, insn.get_op(i)

// Unicorn — opaque uint64 handle, 0 = failure, x86_64 only
uint64 h = uc::create();          // standalone
uint64 h = uc::create_process();  // backed by the attached process (attach first!)
uc::mem_map(h, addr, size, uc::prot::read | uc::prot::exec);
uc::mem_write(h, addr, bytes);
uc::reg_write64(h, x86_reg::rax, value);
uint64 v; uc::reg_read64(h, x86_reg::rax, v);
int err = uc::start(h, begin, end, timeout_us, count);   // uc::error::ok on clean exit
uc::close(h);
```

---

## Common patterns

**Scan + resolve + read:**
```angelscript
uint64 base = process::get_module_base("client.dll");
if (base == 0) return false;
uint64 instr = process::find_signature(base, "48 8B 05 ? ? ? ?");
if (instr == 0) return false;
uint64 ptr = process::get_relative_address(instr, 3, 7);
uint64 list = process::read_uint64(ptr);
if (list == 0) return;
```

**Bulk struct read:**
```angelscript
memory_buffer@ buf = process::read_buffer(entity, 64);
if (buf is null) return;
float hp = buf.read_float(0x334);
vec3 origin = buf.read_vec3_float(0x138);
```

**World to screen:**
```angelscript
vec2 screen;
if (!source2::w2s(world_pos, view_matrix, screen)) continue;   // off-screen / behind camera
render::draw_box((int)screen.x, (int)screen.y, 50, 50, 255,0,0,255, box_style::OUTLINED, 0.0f);
```

**Angle helper:**
```angelscript
vec2 aim = math::calculate_angle(my_pos, target_pos);   // vec2(pitch, yaw)
vec2 smooth = math::smooth_angles(cur, aim, angle_range::R_180, 0.3, 1.0, 45.0);
```

---

## Top crash causes

1. `void main()` instead of `bool main()` returning `true`/`false`.
2. Invented API names — anything outside the namespaces listed above does not exist
   (see `reference/_API_CONTRACT.md` for the full old→new mapping).
3. `uint32` for addresses — use `uint64`.
4. No null check after a pointer read (`if (ptr == 0) return;`).
5. No null check after a signature scan (`if (addr == 0) return;`).
6. `arr.size()` instead of `arr.length()`; `if (h == null)` instead of `if (h is null)`.
7. Colour struct passed to a render call instead of four ints.
8. Drawing outside the render thread.
9. W2S result used as coordinates instead of checking the bool.
10. UI elements registered before their tab/category.
11. Signature scan inside the tick loop — scan once in `main()` and cache the result.
12. Reading memory before `process::attach`.

---

## Anti-cheat surface

Echo is external and read-only by design.

- Never write to game memory on EAC/BattlEye/Vanguard targets.
- Never snap the cursor straight to the target — smooth over multiple ticks.
- Use `create_thread(64, @tick)`, not `create_thread(0, @tick)` (0 runs once and exits).
- Add small timing variance in aim loops, e.g. `sleep(util::random_int(0, 4));`.

---

| File | What it shows |
|------|--------------|
| `templates/basic.as` | Minimal `bool main()` + `on_unload()` |
| `templates/render.as` | ESP box + colour picker |
| `templates/menu.as` | All UI element types |
| `templates/memory.as` | Attach + scan + relative resolve + tick loop |
| `templates/esp-bones.as` | CS2 ESP: box, skeleton, health bar |
| `templates/aimbot.as` | CS2 aimbot: FOV, smoothing, prediction, recoil |
| `templates/radar.as` | 2D circular radar: entity dots, edge arrows |
| `templates/loot.as` | CS2 dropped-weapon ESP: tiered labels, sorted panel |
| `templates/misc.as` | Bunny hop, flash reduction, spectator list |
| `templates/ue5-sdk.as` | UE5 GWorld traversal from Dumper-7 SDK |
| `templates/unity-il2cpp.as` | Unity IL2CPP ESP |
| `templates/valorant.as` | Valorant ESP (VGK external) |
| `templates/fortnite.as` | Fortnite ESP (UE5/EAC) |
